in_hebrew.name: גּרגֶּרדּ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גּרדּ (גּר) + גּגּ (גּ) = דּוּדּ (דּ) - גּרדּ - גּ = root of joy, happiness, and peace. גּגּ - root of earth, ground. דּוּדּ - earth, land, or home. גּרדּ - root of joy, gladness, or happiness. גּ - root of good or earth. דּ - root of ground or earth. Hebrew name Gertrude, means joy of the earth or happiness of the land. In biblical context, the name symbolizes a joyful and peaceful person who finds happiness in the earth and its goodness. The name Gertrude is also associated with the virtue of gratitude and appreciation for the beauty of nature.

in_greek.name: Γερτρούδη
in_greek.long_meaning: Γερ- (Γερ) - root of joy, happiness, or peace. Τρούδη (Τρού) - root of earth, ground. Greek name Gertrude, means joy of the earth or happiness of the land. In New Testament context, the name symbolizes a person who finds joy in the earth and its goodness. The name Gertrude is also associated with the virtue of gratitude and appreciation for the beauty of nature. The name is derived from the Greek word γεράσιμος (gerasimos) meaning 'beloved' or 'joyful'.

in_latin.name: Gertrudis
in_latin.meaning: ger + trudis = joy of the earth
in_latin.long_meaning: ger - root of joy, happiness, or peace. trudis - root of earth, ground. Latin name Gertrude, means joy of the earth or happiness of the land. In early Christian church, the name symbolized a person who finds joy in the earth and its goodness. The name Gertrude is also associated with the virtue of gratitude and appreciation for the beauty of nature. The name is derived from the Latin word 'ger' meaning 'spear' or 'joy', and 'trudis' meaning 'of the earth'.
